The main takeaway from our work is that
the existence of real Killing spinors is not sufficient to guarantee the stability of the corresponding Einstein metric.
the instability of a Riemannian manifold with real Killing spinor implies the existence of an Einstein metric with the same spin structure and with the same dimension and Euler characteristic.
the instability of a Riemannian metric with non-trivial Killing spinors is not a consequence of the non-compactness of the space, but rather of the non-triviality of the Killing spinor.
